svg.text: Welcome back, Michael Arthur. Here’s what’s happening on the farm today.
Observed today · forecast shown, not logged
No nesting. A season’s work is not a tree, and every extra
level of menu is a tap taken standing in the sun.
The header says Offline as a plain fact. Nothing else changes:
every screen still reads and writes with the signal gone.
Task, activity, inventory, expense — the four things logged
most often, reachable from any screen in the app.
The four numbers of the day
Crops in the ground, stock to reorder, work outstanding,
money out. Alerts carry colour; the rest deliberately do not.
The left column is the record — status, activity, cash flow.
The right rail is the queue of things still to be done.
A low-stock row holds the reorder action, so noticing and
acting on it are the same gesture rather than two screens.
